title: Bounded learnit.kit.v3 constructed-response vertical slice

authority.decision: Human GO for learnit.kit.v3 architecture granted 2026-09-13

purpose: Prove the smallest usable learnit.kit.v3 constructed-response flow end to end: explicit V3 admission, bounded free-text response, deterministic Learning-owned evaluation, learner-safe projection, existing persistence, deterministic build and exact-head qualification, while preserving frozen V2 semantics.
invariants: contracts/learnit-kit-v2.schema.json remains byte-identical to the promoted architecture baseline.
Existing qcm and fill validation, import, learner presentation, response capture, scoring, persistence, feedback and learner journey remain behaviorally unchanged.
Learning remains the canonical normalization and evaluation authority; UI and Atlas orchestration never score constructed responses.
Constructed ActivityPresentation contains only type and prompt; acceptedResponses and equivalent scoring secrets never cross the learner-facing boundary.
Constructed responses are bounded to 4000 Unicode code points, reject canonical blank text and are compared case-sensitively after NFC plus Unicode-whitespace canonicalization.
Existing progress persistence is reused through the learner-safe normalized response and boolean outcome; no new persistent schema is introduced.
No planner, evidence, recommendation, memory, transfer, claim-authority, storage architecture, authoring pipeline or central CI-router semantics are changed.
The source manifest is rebound only to actually changed product sources and its canonical self fingerprint.
requiredEvidence: Exact product diff contains exactly the ten governed allowed paths and no others.
Dedicated exact-head constructed-response qualification passes on the candidate SHA.
Repository Governance and PR Scope pass on the same exact candidate SHA.
V2 schema Git blob identity equals the architecture baseline blob.
The V3 fixture has valid activity, course and package canonical digests and runs through explicit V3 import.
Constructed normalization proves NFC equivalence, Unicode whitespace collapse, case-sensitive comparison, blank rejection and the 4000-character bound.
ActivityPresentation and rendered learner markup contain no acceptedResponses, acceptedValues, evaluator, rubric, answer key or scoring-rule secret.
Existing Atlas qcm/fill core, learning, experience, integration and UX clarity regressions remain green.
Learn-it Next deterministic build succeeds and the exact built HTML artifact SHA-256 is captured for immutable Human Replay.
adversarialTests: Reject blank or whitespace-only constructed responses before scoring.
Reject a constructed response longer than 4000 Unicode code points before scoring.
Accept canonically equivalent NFC and Unicode-whitespace variants but reject a case-only variant when the accepted response case differs.
Fail qualification if any constructed scoring secret appears in ActivityPresentation or learner markup.
Fail qualification if V3 import delegates to the legacy V2 base service.
Fail qualification if any path outside the exact ten-file product scope changes.
Fail qualification if frozen V2 schema blob identity changes or qcm/fill regression suites fail.
nonGoals: LLM-as-a-judge, probabilistic scoring, embeddings or remote correction.
A generic rubric engine, scoring DSL, activity plugin runtime or universal activity framework.
A new event architecture, persistence database, storage schema or general version abstraction.
Changes to planner, evidence, recommendation, memory, transfer, claim authority or authoring.
Changes to the central Learn-it Next CI router.
Product merge or promotion before immutable Human Replay and explicit final human acceptance.
independentReview: Dedicated CI must independently recompute exact changed-path scope and V2 schema identity from Git rather than trusting this work package.
Existing ActivityPresentation seam qualification remains an independent regression oracle for qcm/fill and learner-secret boundaries.
The new constructed-response test independently recomputes fixture digests and attacks normalization and secret-boundary failure modes.
Final product acceptance remains a separate human replay gate on the exact machine-qualified immutable artifact.
rollback: Revert the single bounded product commit to exact execution baseline 1e71271436fd4b7dd7d895cfec827833187630fe. No V2 contract, persistent schema, authoring artifact or control-plane state is changed by this slice.
